judgeCorrections.struck: The iron sweep (run G) branch-1 'H-C mass present' stamp is STRUCK by the blind post-op judge (2026-08-15), binding: section C's closure clause reads 'residual > 0.25 -> INCONCLUSIVE regardless of branch hits', and iron's residual is 0.2579; carrying the failed clause onto only the demoted H-B remainder was a post-hoc reinterpretation. The arm's branch is corrected to branch 5 MIXED/INCONCLUSIVE by the letter of the pre-committed clause; the original reading is retained in `observedCeilingExcess` as 'H-C-candidate event-rate excess, observed, not established'. applyDecisionRule now encodes the corrected ordering.
judgeCorrections.noisePowerOnCeilingTest: Judge's arithmetic, annotating the ceiling test: at iron's credit fraction (~429 quiet bins of ~509 usable), the C4 quiet false-event rate reproduces the branch-1 margin — at the per-source 6.93% the true event rate is ~2.8 bins/s (below the raw ceiling 3.59); even at the gate-passing pooled 4.22% it is ~3.6 bins/s (below the 4.13 threshold). The x1.15 factor lacked power against a <=5% noise gate at this credit fraction. Coherence: the closure failing in the direction O_eff x S (2.04) > rho (1.62) is the signature of event-count inflation relative to mass — the two flags are one story.
judgeCorrections.rhoSystematicsBand: rho's elevation is a 1.6-1.9x BAND, not a constant: banked-at-paint mass is 14% of iron's Sigma real Delta (134.2/946.1) riding the 0.13-0.22s bar-paint lateness, and the one-sided exclusion of negative-Delta reads truncates noise asymmetrically (unquantified).
